messages:
sam: Hi @people-ops. My spouse had a telehealth visit last week but the insurer denied the claim saying dependent not on file. Our digital ID card shows spouse added. I have the appointment invoice and the EOB denial. What gives?

benefits-bot: Helpful link: Claims & Enrollment FAQs at https://benefits.redwood.com/faqs. Common reasons for denial: relationship mismatch (domestic partner vs spouse), SSN mismatch, or enrollment effective date. Please attach EOB and member/enrollment info in the portal.

Priya: Hey Sam  sorry you're dealing with that. Can you confirm: 1) the dependent name on the digital card, 2) relationship on the enrollment form (spouse vs domestic partner), 3) the dependent SSN or TIN that was submitted? Sometimes carriers treat domestic partners differently and require supplemental paperwork.

sam: Member ID: 666112233. Digital card shows "Alex Kim (spouse)". Enrollment form I filled said "spouse" and I uploaded marriage certificate during onboarding. The EOB says "coverage not in effect for dependent: mismatch of relationship code". I didn't include SSN when I added them since I thought it synced from payroll docs.

Priya: Thanks. Given the EOB language, likely the carrier has the dependent recorded as "domestic partner" or missing SSN. Two options: 1) We can open an enrollment verification with the carrier to correct relationship coding (needs marriage certificate + dependent SSN). Typical turnaround 7-14 business days. 2) If this was within 30 days of hire or a qualifying life event, we can request retrospective enrollment correction to cover the service date; otherwise insurer may deny retro coverage.

sam: The visit was 2026-03-10, which is within our new-hire 30-day window (I joined 2026-03-01). I can provide SSN and resend marriage cert. Please proceed with correction request.

enrollment-admin: Copying action: I'll submit carrier case now. Please upload SSN (redact on public threads) to portal under Secure Docs > Enrollment, and mark it "urgent - claim denial". I'll attach the EOB and marriage cert. Submitting as case CASE-20260314-21.

Priya: Also note: if carrier accepts retrospective enroll, they will reprocess the claim and send updated EOB. If they still deny for another reason we'll escalate to broker. I'll monitor and post updates.

sam: Uploaded SSN and EOB to the portal and flagged the document. Thanks for the quick help.

enrollment-admin: Case submitted to carrier. Expected carrier acknowledgement in 2-3 business days. I'll update with carrier case number and any reprocessed claim EOB when available. If carrier requires notarized documents we'll let you know.

Priya: Follow-up: carrier acknowledged case and asked for dependent SSN confirmation (they saw blank). I confirmed with them that payroll docs include SSN but carrier lacked it. Carrier set pending until we provide the SSN (we already provided). They estimated reprocess in 10 business days.

sam: Appreciate it. Will wait for the reprocessed EOB. If it gets rejected again, please escalate to benefits broker.

Priya: Will do. Keeping thread open until claim reprocessed. :thumbsup:
